card.name: Chinese characters in English text
card.fires_on: Chinese characters or their bytes inserted in English text, such as glosses and names in brackets. Also the colon inside a clock time in a file listing.

modes.label: Chinese gloss in English
modes.description: A Chinese character right after an English term or name, often in brackets.
modes.example: Yu Yongfu (<<于>>永福) ; Michael G. Gilbert

modes.label: Colon in clock time
modes.description: The colon between hour and minute in a Unix file listing.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese or mixed, with no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on Chinese characters tucked into English text, and on the colon in times in computer file listings.
